ls_4446_2273_0017.text: HOW JOLLY IT WAS BEING YOUNG HILDA

ls_4446_2273_0019.text: COME WE'LL HAVE OUR COFFEE IN THE OTHER ROOM AND YOU CAN SMOKE

ls_4446_2275_0038.text: I WILL ASK THE LEAST IMAGINABLE BUT I MUST HAVE SOMETHING

swx_m01.text: I would like to describe an old lighthouse on the coast near my town.

swx_m02.text: It is a tall white tower with a red roof.

swx_m03.text: It was built more than one hundred years ago.

swx_m04.text: Today it is a small museum.

swx_m05.text: Inside there is a narrow staircase with about two hundred steps.

swx_m06.text: At the top you can see the sea for many miles.

swx_m07.text: I first visited it with my school when I was ten.

swx_m08.text: Our teacher told us stories about the ships that sank nearby.

swx_m09.text: I find it interesting because it shows how people lived in the past.

swx_m10.text: I still go there once or twice a year.

swx_m11.text: The building next to the tower was once the keeper's house.

swx_m12.text: The keeper and his family lived there all year round.

swx_m13.text: In winter the storms were so bad that they could not leave for weeks.

swx_m14.text: Now the house has a small cafe and a shop that sells old maps.

swx_m15.text: Last summer I took my nephew there for the first time.

swx_m17.text: For me the lighthouse links my childhood with the history of my town.

swy_m01.text: I want to talk about a train journey I took last spring.

swy_m02.text: I travelled from my home town to the coast with my cousin.

swy_m04.text: We left very early in the morning.

swy_m05.text: The train was full of families going on holiday.

swy_m06.text: Through the window we could see farms and small villages.

swy_m07.text: In the middle of the journey the train stopped for an hour.

swy_m08.text: Nobody told us why so we played cards to pass the time.

swy_m09.text: When we finally arrived the sun was shining.

swy_m10.text: We went straight to the beach and had an ice cream.

swy_m11.text: I remember it well because it was my first trip without my parents.

swy_m12.text: My cousin had brought a camera and took photos of everything.

swy_m13.text: In the afternoon we walked along the cliffs above the harbour.

swy_m14.text: The wind was so strong that we could hardly stand up.

swy_m15.text: Later we found a little cafe that sold fresh fish and chips.

swy_m16.text: We sat by the window and watched the boats come in.

swy_m17.text: The journey home was much quieter because we were both tired.

swy_m18.text: I fell asleep before the train had even left the station.

swy_m19.text: Since then I have taken that train many times.

swy_m20.text: But the first trip is still the one I remember best.
